units.service: ms per source record (batch value / source_records)
units.compute: sum over a batch's records of wall time measured around each member callable
units.other_overhead: per-batch end-to-end time minus that batch's summed member wall time; not pure network time

ray.annotation: N/A (Cedar clips the offloaded block to 0)

units.cost: ms per source record of one worker (Cedar's model has no W)
units.bytes: serialized bytes per source record, from the profile's baseline input/output sizes
units.latency_share_f_i: fraction of the profiled whole-pipeline latency
units.io_bytes: byte-level split of the same I/O accounting _calculate_cost_fused applies to costs

notes.fusion_discount: _calculate_cost_fused is byte-identical in the import commit, the vendored snapshot and the current file: the discount formula itself is original Cedar code and is backend-agnostic (it consumes an already backend-priced pipe_cost_map).
notes.backend_enumeration: _offload_and_fuse/_local_fusion/_fuse_local_smp/_fuse_tf are byte-identical: the original search enumerates RAY (non-TF, offload+fusion on), TF_RAY (TF graphs), TF (all-TF) and SMP (only when local parallelism is forbidden). It never fuses plain INPROCESS pipes.
notes.materialized_fused_pricing: calculate_cost gained the 'materialized fused node' branch and multi-group fused_pipes support after the import commit, and _is_optimizer_pipe gained its plan argument. Pricing an already-materialized fused block (including an INPROCESS one) is therefore an extension, not original search behaviour.
notes.inprocess_shortcut: _calculate_pipe_cost gained an early return for None/INPROCESS variants; the Amdahl inversion and its clip-to-zero threshold are unchanged from the import commit.
